summary: XPeng Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting July 2026 vehicle delivery results, a routine operational update. The press release details 38,027 deliveries (up 4% year-over-year), cumulative deliveries exceeding 1.2 million units, and global expansion plans including the L03 launch in 65 countries and Australian market entry. No special-situation event is present. This is an ordinary current report on operational performance, not a capital markets transaction. The filing includes no financial terms, M&A activity, or strategic review. Conservative classification as 'None' is appropriate.
